title: Desktop 书库删除完成快照兼容修复

commits.message: fix(desktop): delete immutable snapshots before books

commits.multi_change_reason: Shared v1.3.8 version preparation commit covers every included release fix.

user_summary: 修复含已完成全书快照的书籍无法从桌面书库删除的问题。
technical_summary: Delete immutable book snapshots before their live source chapters so SQLite does not invoke ON DELETE SET NULL updates rejected by completed-snapshot immutability triggers.
acceptance_criteria: A book with a completed immutable snapshot can be deleted from the library.
Deleting a book removes its snapshot chapters and paragraphs without weakening snapshot immutability triggers.
A failed delete remains transactional and leaves book and analysis data unchanged.
tests: Book deletion and collection regression suite: 23 passed
Completed immutable snapshot trigger regression passed
Ruff F/I checks and git diff check passed
Project scaffold and Change Registry checks passed
verification_evidence: Installed 1.3.8 log: DELETE chapters for book 60 failed with sqlite update_completed_forbidden

data_compatibility.notes: No schema migration. The fix only orders deletions within the existing transaction.
